notes.title: Version 1.27 Beta Test
notes.content:
Instructions on downloading the beta test version:
http://www.alistersoftware.co.za/files/opt%20into%20beta.jpg

[u]Delta Quadrant 1.27 - Change log[/u]

[list]

[*] UI - Items on cool down or disabled are now displayed more clearly with less color.

[*] UI - Top left values will flash red in warning when there are no moves, no shields or low hull integrity.

[*] UI - Reworked and reduced some windows and font sizes.

[*] UI - Added new Popup Window: Sector End (If all enemies have been destroyed you will receive a option to jump to next sector)

[*] UI - Added new Popup Window: Reinforcements (If an enemy calls in reinforcements like the Trading Station you will receive a notification pop-up)

[*] UI - Added new Popup Window: Hack Successful (If you have successfully hacked the comms relay this window will show)

[*] Game play - Mounting of items on the ship screen no longer trigger the cooldown of the item.

[*] Game play - You will start each new sector with full moves available.

[/list]

[*] UI - Added new Popup Window: Hack Successful (If you have successfully hacked the comms relay this window will show)

notes.title: Version 1.25 Beta Test
notes.content:
Instructions on downloading the beta test version:
http://www.alistersoftware.co.za/files/opt%20into%20beta.jpg

[u]Delta Quadrant 1.25 - Change log[/u]

[list]
[*]Removed double esc to quit game. New quit popup menu will appear on first press of esc key.

[*]At the end of the first turn on a new sector a exit to skills popup menu will appear if the player has any unspent skill points.

[*]New menu music by Scheve (Thank you!)

[*]Items on the ship screen doesn’t stay selected when you return to the ship screen.

[*]Fixed a bug that caused the player ship to move while clicking on the interface buttons at the bottom.

[*]Fixed the bug that allowed the player to move while it was busy with the enemy turn.

[*]Map can be scrolled with mouse scroll wheel and keyboard keys:
(UP - R, Up Arrow, Page UP, NumMinus)  (Down - F, Down Arrow, Page Down, NumPlus)

[*]Map will now follow player ship movement

[*]Dismantle, Salvage and Convert will now scale with item rank and player level.

[*]Added a new setting to the settings screen - Single Click Attack (Will attack enemy on first click without confirming the attack and damage)
[/list]

We want to give a big thank you to everyone who has played the game so far, and for each person who took the time to write a review - even the negative ones! We appreciate your time and support!

notes.title: Version 1.24 - Another achievement bug squashed
notes.content:
Fixed another little troublemaker causing achievements not to trigger.

We are still waiting for Valve to activate the steam trading cards from their side. I have set the card drop rate to the quickest rate possible. So when it gets activated you should be able to quickly receive your cards.

Sorry for the delay.

tags.bug: Fixed another little troublemaker causing achievements not to trigger.

notes.title: Version 1.23 - Start values + achievement bug
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the shield and hull values were incorrect after you died and started a new game.

Fixed a bug where some of the achievements (specifically the trader achievement) were not triggering correctly. 

If you don't see the update, please restart steam.

Please keep up the excellent feedback everyone. Some urgent ones I will do as quickly as possible, but I don't want to break it with untested changes. I have already pushed my luck a bit to get these fixed to you as fast as possible.
